_note: Denver shared-micromobility rate history. Feeds pricing comparisons; the eventual GET /api/v1/meta/pricing (see MULTI_TENANCY_PLAN.md 7e) should serve this rather than the frontend hardcoding it. Amounts in CENTS.
_provenance_warning: The rates that matter for a rider-facing comparison are the LEAST citable ones. Lime -- whose 30/60-minute passes are what Denver riders actually bought -- publishes NO pricing feed at all: system_pricing_plans 404s and is absent from their GBFS discovery document. Lyft publishes rack rates only (data/lyft_den_pricing_2024-12-16.json), and no bundle. So a price comparison assembled from open data can only ever show walk-up rates, which is not what anyone paid. Plans below carry a per-plan `cited` flag; do not publish a derived multiple that depends on an uncited plan. Note also that Lyft's feed is abandoned rather than merely stale: its freeze stamp post-dates its own operating period by an unknown margin, so nothing in it can be dated. Lime is the meaningful comparator for Denver -- and the one that publishes no pricing at all.

source.all: Denver licensing agreement (Exhibit C, Multi-Year Pricing Plan); mirrored in denver-scooter-fyi/src/config.ts RATE_PLANS

plans.label: Access Program (income-qualified)
plans._note: Renamed from 'Equity program'. It is a RIDER TIER and was sharing a name with the geographic Equity Area discount below, which is a different Exhibit C row -- the collision is how a rider concludes they are already getting the area discount. The key stays 'equity' because it is the rate_plan enum value in PUT /api/v1/profile and riders have it stored. cited=false: Exhibit C states a 0.19/min CAP on additional time for this tier, not the 15/min rate below, which comes from Veo's own program materials and sits under that cap.

plans.label: Equity Area pricing
plans.applies: any trip that starts or ends within a designated Equity Area
plans.source_citation: Exhibit A 5.2 (obligation); Exhibit C, Equity Area Pricing row (rate)
plans._note: NOT a tier a rider picks -- kind='geographic', automatic=true. A 10-minute/1-mile ride is 2.30 here against 4.90 at the base price. The 1.00 unlock is part of the discounted row, so a rider seeing a 1 unlock on a receipt has not necessarily been denied the discount.

operators._note: Exhibit C's pricing table has FOUR rows and they are not all the same KIND of thing. Base Price, Resident Pass and the Access Program are rider tiers -- which bracket a person is enrolled in. Equity Area Pricing is geographic and automatic: Exhibit A 5.2 obliges Veo to discount 'any trip that starts or ends within a designated Equity Area' regardless of the rider's tier, with no enrollment. It is carried below with kind='geographic' so a consumer cannot mistake it for something a rider selects. Exhibit C gives it no 'Maximums' figure, unlike Base Price (0.49/min cap), Resident Pass (0.33/min) and Access (0.19/min), so no ceiling is recorded here either. Rates are fixed May 2026 - May 2029 and adjustable only for documented cost-of-service increases with DOTI approval (Exhibit A 7.1).
